welcome.title: Welcome to Harmolyn
welcome.body: A private place to talk with friends and communities. Here's a quick tour of the main parts — it takes less than a minute, and you can skip it any time.
welcome.privacyNote: Everything you send is private by default. Look for the lock badge at the top of each chat.

servers.title: Servers are communities
servers.leftColumnBody: Each round icon is a server — a community you've joined or created. Tap one to open it.
servers.joiningBody: Use the + button to create your own server or paste an invite link a friend shared with you.

channels.title: Channels organize the talk
channels.textBody: Inside a server, channels split conversations by topic. Tap a channel name to read and post in it.
channels.findingBody: Search looks through the messages already on your device — results show how complete they are, so you're never misled.

dms.title: Direct messages
dms.oneToOneBody: Direct messages are private conversations between you and one other person, end-to-end encrypted.
dms.friendsBody: Add someone as a friend to start a direct message. You only need their handle — no phone number or email.

voice.title: Voice and video
voice.channelsBody: Tap a voice channel to join a live call. Others in the channel can hear you, and you can turn your camera or screen-share on when you want.
voice.note: If your network can't connect a call directly, Harmolyn tells you plainly instead of failing silently.

settings.title: You're all set
settings.customizeBody: Open Settings to change your name, pick a language, adjust text size, or turn on Simple Mode for a calmer, plainer look.
settings.safetyBody: Create an encrypted backup of your identity early — it's the only way to recover your account if you lose your device.
